sql_schemas: table leave_request | fields: id, employee_id, leave_policy_id, start_date, end_date, reason, status, approved_by, approved_at, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employee.id; leave_policy_id -> leave_policy.id; approved_by -> employee.id | indexes: employee_id: frequent lookups to retrieve all leave requests for a given employee; status: filtering and counting requests by status (SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED); start_date, end_date: range queries for calendar views and overlap detection when validating new requests; leave_policy_id: filtering requests by leave type (annual, sick, emergency)

table leave_balance | fields: id, employee_id, leave_policy_id, total_entitlement, used_days, remaining_days, fiscal_year, status, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employee.id; leave_policy_id -> leave_policy.id | indexes: employee_id: lookups to retrieve all balances for a given employee; leave_policy_id: filtering balances by policy/leave type; fiscal_year: filtering balances by fiscal year for accrual and reset operations; employee_id, leave_policy_id, fiscal_year: unique constraint enforcement — one balance row per employee per policy per fiscal year

table leave_policy | fields: id, policy_name, leave_type, entitlement_days, accrual_rate, max_accumulation, minimum_notice_days, requires_manager_approval, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | indexes: leave_type: filtering policies by leave type (annual, sick, emergency); is_active: filtering only active policies for assignment and validation

table audit_log | fields: id, entity_type, entity_id, action, old_values, new_values, performed_by, performed_at, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: performed_by -> employee.id | indexes: entity_type, entity_id: lookups to retrieve all audit records for a specific entity; performed_by: lookups to retrieve all actions performed by a specific user; performed_at: time-range queries for audit reports; action: filtering audit records by action type (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, APPROVE, REJECT)

methods: findOverlapping(employeeId: string, startDate: Date, endDate: Date, excludeId?: string): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>
updateStatus(id: string, status: LeaveStatus, approvedBy?: string, approvedAt?: Date): Promise<LeaveRequest>
findByEmployeeAndPolicy(employeeId: string, leavePolicyId: string, fiscalYear: number): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>
updateUsedDays(id: string, usedDays: number, remainingDays: number): Promise<LeaveBalance>
updateEntitlement(id: string, totalEntitlement: number, remainingDays: number): Promise<LeaveBalance>
findByPerformer(performedBy: string, params?: { from?: Date; to?: Date }): Promise<AuditLog[]>

data_notes: Tables defined: leave_request, leave_balance, leave_policy, audit_log. The employee table is referenced via FK but belongs to the employee module — not redefined here. The leave_request table uses leave_policy_id (not leave_type_id) to link to the policy that governs the leave type, aligning with the domain model where LeavePolicy carries leave_type. The audit_log table is included per GP-002 (all state-changing operations must write an audit record). All repositories use PostgreSQL via the shared pg Pool at src/shared/db/connection.ts. Indexes are designed for the primary access patterns: employee-scoped lookups, status filtering, date-range overlap detection, and fiscal-year balance queries.
